* A child implementation of the {@link dalvik.system.ZipPathValidator.Callback} that removes the
 * risk of zip path traversal vulnerabilities.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: VALIDATE_ZIP_PATH_FOR_PATH_TRAVERSAL
variables.comment:
* This change targets zip path traversal vulnerabilities by throwing * {@link java.util.zip.ZipException} if zip path entries contain ".." or start with "/". *

* The exception will be thrown in {@link java.util.zip.ZipInputStream#getNextEntry} or * {@link java.util.zip.ZipFile#ZipFile(String)}. *

* This validation is enabled for apps with targetSDK >= U.

methods.name: public void onZipEntryAccess(@NonNull String path) throws ZipException

methodNames: public void onZipEntryAccess(@NonNull String path) throws ZipException
